scope: Execution ATR only: full-period relative-TR SMA14 versus full-period price-TR SMA14/signal-close; compare to original mixed ATR
frozen_selection: C04_NEW, original frozen signal dates, symbols, order, scores and model features unchanged
relative_formula: Reproduce run_batch_002: r=(close/preclose-1).where(tradestatus==1), chain=cumprod(1+r.fillna(0)); prior=chain.shift(1); adjusted high/low=chain*high_or_low/close; relative_TR=max(adjusted_high-adjusted_low,abs(adjusted_high-prior),abs(adjusted_low-prior))/prior; clip(SMA14(relative_TR),.015,.05)
data: Pre2025 both ATR formulas use retained original model/technical panel outputs to avoid revised qfq rounding (49 relative signal rows drift on latest qfq). Post2024 alternatives computed causally on verified local qfq bars; price ATR must match frozen post outputs. No future records beyond signal date affect ATR; input hashes and overlap checks retained.
unchanged: quantity with original .2% slippage buffer floored to 100 shares
evaluation_status: Historical execution sensitivity including already-seen posterior, not new blind test; no training, selection or production replacement
